page.layout: One printed page, essentially blank. Faint show-through of text from the reverse side is visible in the centre and left; a handwritten inscription "Gal. 8. 118." sits at the top right in ink. No printed text on this page.
page.notes: Handwritten ink inscription at top right ("Gal. 8. 118.") is manuscript, not printed, and is therefore left out. Faint mirrored text and ghost letters in the centre and left are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are not transcribed. Scanned page edges and dark background are the digitiser's surround and are omitted.
